data.name: Nufaylah
data.gender_notes: Nufaylah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is radiant and luminous. The name Nufaylah carries the meaning “Radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Nufaylah usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A shining beacon of faith and hope
data.etymology: Nufaylah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nufaylah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: نُفَيْلَة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يعني الزيادة والنمو في الخير والصلاح
in_arabic.long_meaning: نُفَيْلَة هو اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، مشتق من الفعل 'نَفَلَ' الذي يعني الزيادة والنمو. يرمز الاسم إلى الزيادة في الخير والصلاح، وقد ورد في بعض الآثار الإسلامية أن النُفَيْلَة تعني الهدية أو العطية من الله تعالى. وقد استخدم هذا الاسم في التاريخ الإسلامي كتسمية لبعض النساء من أصحاب النبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم وأمته.

in_urdu.name: نفیلہ
in_urdu.meaning: نام کا مطلب ہے اضافہ اور بھلائی میں ترقی
in_urdu.long_meaning: نفیلہ ایک عربی मूल کا اسم علم مؤنث ہے، جو کہ 'نَفَلَ' فعل سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے اضافہ اور ترقی کرنا۔ یہ نام اسلامی تاریخ میں بعض صاحبات النبی محمد صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ و سلم کی تسمیت کے لیے استعمال کیا گیا ہے۔ اس نام کا روحانی مطلب ہے اللہ تعالی کی جانب سے دی گئی عطا یا تحفہ۔

in_hindi.name: नुफैला
in_hindi.meaning: इस नाम का अर्थ है अच्छाई में वृद्धि और उन्नति
in_hindi.long_meaning: नुफैला एक अरबी मूल का स्त्रीलिंग नाम है, जो 'नफल' क्रिया से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है वृद्धि करना और आगे बढ़ना। इस नाम का अर्थ है अल्लाह की ओर से प्राप्त आशीर्वाद और दान। इस्लामी परंपरा में, यह नाम उन स्त्रियों के लिए उपयोग किया गया है जो सच्चाई और धार्मिकता के मार्ग पर चलती हैं।

in_english.name: Nufaylah
in_english.meaning: The name signifies increase and growth in goodness and righteousness
in_english.long_meaning: Nufaylah is a feminine given name of Arabic origin, derived from the verb 'nafala,' which means to increase or grow. The name symbolizes growth in goodness, righteousness, and spiritual development. In Islamic tradition, Nufaylah has been used to signify a gift or blessing from Allah. Historically, the name has been associated with companions of the Prophet Muhammad and has been used across various Muslim cultures to denote a person who brings positivity and blessings.

data.cultural_impact: The name Nufaylah can be seen as a symbol of resilience, as it comes from the Arabic word 'nufil' which means 'to be radiant' or 'to shine'. In Arab and Islamic culture, to be radiant or shining is often associated with strength, power, and determination. The name can be an inspiring reminder to never lose your inner light, especially in times of struggle or adversity.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, light is often used as a metaphor for knowledge, guidance, and spiritual growth. The name Nufaylah can be seen as a reminder of the importance of keeping our inner light (our spiritual connection with Allah) shining bright through our actions and words. It also highlights the belief that every individual has the potential to shine and make a positive impact on the world.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Radiant" symbolizes One who is radiant and luminous. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Nufaylah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of radiant.
